title: query_features inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the discovery/query feature-query tool (advertised name honua_query_features). Reads features from a published layer with an optional attribute and spatial filter. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

serviceId.description: Published service identifier or name (from list_layers.serviceId).

where.description: Optional attribute filter expressed as an ArcGIS/SQL WHERE clause.

bbox.description: Optional spatial filter envelope as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY].

bboxSrid.description: Spatial reference (SRID/WKID) of the bbox ordinates.

outFields.description: Optional attribute fields to return; omit for all fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of features to return (capped at 1000).

outSrid.description: Output spatial reference (SRID/WKID) for returned geometries.
